issues.description: Define editable field metadata for Dynamic HTML templates, initially supporting text and asset fields.

issues.summary: Map preview elements to content fields
issues.description: Support data-slider-field mapping between rendered elements and slide content.
Resolve declared repeated paths such as cards[].title to concrete paths such as cards[2].title.
Add focused no-code controls for the currently selected Dynamic HTML field.
Allow clicking editable rendered elements to select their content field.
Allow presentation authors to edit Dynamic HTML text directly from the slide canvas.
Replace or remove asset fields using Slider's existing Asset picker.
Show hover and selection outlines only inside the presentation editor.

issues.summary: Add safe nested content path helpers
issues.description: Add safe immutable get/set helpers for nested objects and array indexes with prototype-pollution protection.
Add a compact UI for declaring text and asset fields without raw schema authoring.
Verify autosave and full reload persistence for no-code Dynamic HTML edits.
Add focused runtime, security and persistence coverage and update Template Studio documentation.
